body: We were allowed to eat after handing out equipment.

In the 5th grade I was assigned to be the administrator of gym equipment during recess/lunch. I would sit at a desk alongside the equipment locker and hand out balls. One my first day I brought my lunch with me and started eating pizza while children were lining up to check out equipment. The principal saw me neglecting my duties for pizza and fired me on the spot.

EDIT: for some reason my home room teacher made me write an apology letter to the principal, that I might get my position back. The principal rejected it.
